Raj (Eng Manager): Quick question before cycle: can we get a 1-paragraph OKR-linked self-review + a short manager rubric I can paste into Slack? Want people to tie wins directly to OKRs, not just tasks.
Emma (People Ops): Yup — made a tiny pasteable block for exactly that. Short, OKR-first. Use in 1:1s or send as a DM.
Emma (People Ops): ```Self-review (OKR-linked, ~5m)
- OKR tie (1 line): Which team OKR(s) did your work support, and how (metric or outcome)?
- Win snapshot (1 line): One concrete result and its impact (metric if available).
- What changed your plan (1 line): constraints or tradeoffs that mattered.
- Next cycle ask (1 line): one goal and one ask from your manager.

Manager note (pasteable, ~3 lines)
- Rating + OKR impact (1 line): e.g., "Meets 1% toward OKR X via Y".
- Evidence (12 short bullets): concrete behavior + result.
- Development ask (1 line): clear next step tied to an OKR.
```
Talia (Product Manager): Love the OKR link. Could there be a tiny guidance line for engineers on how to quantify impact?
Emma (People Ops): Add this micro guidance: "When possible, use percent change, absolute counts, or user-facing outcomes (e.g., latency, conversion, alerts reduced). If you cant measure, state the user or business effect"
Owen (Principal Eng): Manager tip: when you give a rating, include one short example that directly maps to the OKR metric. Keeps calibration consistent.
Emma (People Ops): Also a quick rating snippet you can copy: "Exceeds: clearly advances OKRs with measurable impact and mentors others. Meets: delivers against OKRs and reliably completes owned outcomes. Needs support: OKR progress incomplete or inconsistent; needs a development plan."
people-ops-bot: Heads-up: calibration forms open in two weeks. Submit manager notes and link to each IC's self-review. Deadline: 1754018000. Link: https://intranet.redwood/calibrate
Raj (Eng Manager): This is great, Emma. Ill paste into my team channel and ask for 5-minute fills before Friday. Thanks! :clap:
